### node_management
  operation                        Choice         T1 required
      help: Node operation to perform
      choices (3): cordon | drain | uncordon
  nodeName                         Text           T1
      help: Name of the node to operate on (required for cordon, drain, uncordon)
  force                            Boolean        T1

      default: false
  gracePeriod                      Number         T1
      help: Period of time in seconds given to each pod to terminate gracefully (for drain operation).
      default: -1

      default: false
  ignoreDaemonsets                 Boolean        T1
      help: Ignore DaemonSet-managed pods (for drain operation)

      default: "0"

      default: false
